name: fellow-aiden-mcp
description: Manage Fellow Aiden brew profiles from Claude: photo a bag, get a profile, keep tasting notes.

FELLOW_EMAIL.description: The email you sign in to the **Fellow app** with (the account your Aiden is registered to).

FELLOW_PASSWORD.description: Your Fellow app password. Stored encrypted as a Worker secret; only sent to Fellow.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: A new password you make up, **12+ characters**. You type it once when connecting Claude, so nobody else who finds your URL can use it.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores sign-in state. Created for you.

DB.description: Your coffee library: profiles, tasting notes, ratings, equipment. Created for you.
